scanNote:
WORKBOOK 3-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (13-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Shop till you Drop!' va to'q sariq '3'.

CHAP USTUN:
(4-mashq davomi): 7 That's a heavy box. 8 I can't find my black sweater. 9 Helen is a very pretty girl. 10 Prague is a beautiful city.
5) 'Fill in the gaps with the opposite of the adjectives in bold.' 1 A: Is your mother a young woman? B: No, she's quite ...... . 2 A: Is that bag heavy? B: No, it's very ...... . 3 A: Did Sally buy an expensive car? B: No, she bought a ...... one. 4 A: Does she wear short skirts? B: No, she wears ...... skirts. 5 A: Do you live in a small house? B: No, I live in a ...... house. 6 A: Is London an ugly city? B: No, it's a very ...... city. 7 A: Is 'Titanic' a boring film? B: No, it's a very ...... film. 8 A: Do you have a light blue jumper? B: No, I have a ...... blue jumper.
6) 'Look at the pictures below, then fill in the gaps with adjectives from the list, as in the example.' Qiya: 'warm, rectangular, rubber, leather, woollen, small, old, big, cotton, round'. 6 RASM: 1 basketbol to'pi; 2 jun qo'lqoplar; 3 rezina o'rdakcha; 4 Amerika bayrog'i; 5 kovboy etigi; 6 yozuv taxtasi (bo'r bilan). 1 It's a(n) ...round rubber... basketball. 2 They're ...... gloves. 3 It's a(n) ...... duck. 4 It's a(n) ...... American flag. 5 It's a(n) ...... cowboy boot. 6 It's a(n) ...... blackboard.

O'NG USTUN:
7) 'Put the adjectives into the correct order.' 1 a brown/wooden/large bed; 2 a silk/small/black shirt; 3 a square/blue/big box; 4 a leather/light/grey briefcase; 5 a tiny/red/round ball; 6 a velvet/lovely/blue dress; 7 a(n) big/white/expensive car; 8 a(n) nylon/green/old rucksack.
8) 'Fill in must or can't.' 1 A: Is this your bag? B: No. It ...... be Elaine's. Her address book is inside. 2 A: Is this John's jacket? B: No. It ...... be his. It's too small. 3 A: Is this Tim's £20 note? B: No. It ...... be. Tim's spent all his money. 4 A: Is this Don's shirt? B: Yes. It ...... be his. He always wears bright colours. 5 A: Is this Anne's bracelet? B: No. It ...... be hers. She only likes silver jewellery.
9) 'Make speculations about the people in the pictures as in the examples.' Qiya: 'businessman, student, 18 years old, married, pilot, single, earn a lot of money, work long hours'. IKKI SURAT: Sarah (ryukzakli, kurtkali yosh qiz, orqada daraxtlar); Timothy (kostyumli erkak telefonda gaplashyapti, orqada Big Ben/Parlament). Qiya namuna: 'She must be a student. She can't be married.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '13'.

4-MAShQ DAVOMI (12-betdan).

  7 heavy → F (og'irlik - o'lchanadi)
  8 black → F (rang)
  9 pretty → O (baho)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the opposite of the adjectives in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qalin harfli sifatlarning antonimi bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ANTONIMLAR (qarama-qarshi
  sifatlar):

  young ↔ OLD
  heavy ↔ LIGHT
  expensive ↔ CHEAP
  short ↔ LONG
  small ↔ BIG / LARGE
  ugly ↔ BEAUTIFUL
  boring ↔ INTERESTING / EXCITING
  light (blue) ↔ DARK (blue)


⚠ 'LIGHT' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) yengil (heavy ning aksi)
  2) och (rang: light blue)
  ⚠ 2-gapda 'yengil', 8-gapda
  'och'.


⚠ 'QUITE':

  = ancha. 'quite old' = ancha
  keksa (yumshoq).


⚠ 'ONE' = O'RNIDA:

  'a cheap ONE' = a cheap car
  (takrorlamaslik uchun).


⚠ 'TITANIC':

  = 1997-yilgi film (Leonardo
  DiCaprio).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures below, then fill in the gaps with adjectives from the list, as in the example: warm, rectangular, rubber, leather, woollen, small, old, big, cotton, round. Pictures: 1 basketball, 2 gloves, 3 duck, 4 American flag, 5 cowboy boot, 6 blackboard.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmlarga qarang, so'ng bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi sifatlar bilan to'ldiring, namunadagidek: warm, rectangular, rubber, leather, woollen, small, old, big, cotton, round. Rasmlar: 1 basketbol to'pi, 2 qo'lqoplar, 3 o'rdakcha, 4 Amerika bayrog'i, 5 kovboy etigi, 6 yozuv taxtasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATLAR TARTIBI (coursebook
  20-bet qoidasi):

  FIKR → O'LChAM → YOSh → ShAKL →
  RANG → MATERIAL + OT

  round (shakl) + rubber (material)
  warm (fikr/xususiyat) + woollen
    (material)
  small (o'lcham) + rubber (material)
  big (o'lcham) + cotton (material)
  old (yosh) + leather (material)
  big (o'lcham) + rectangular (shakl)

  ⚠ MATERIAL HAR DOIM OXIRIDA
  (otdan oldin).


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'It's a round rubber basketball.'


⚠ 10 SIFAT, 6 RASM - 'rubber' va
  'big' ikki marta ishlatiladi
  (to'p va o'rdak ikkalasi rezina).


⚠ 'A(N)':

  'It's a(n) ...' - birinchi sifat
  unli bilan boshlansa 'an': 'an
  old leather cowboy boot'.


⚠ 'WOOLLEN':

  = jun (sifat). Brit. ikki 'l'.


⚠ 'RUBBER':

  = rezina. 'a rubber duck' =
  rezina o'rdakcha (hammom
  o'yinchog'i).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the adjectives into the correct order.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATLAR TARTIBI (coursebook
  20-bet 12-mashq):

  1 FIKR (lovely, expensive)
  2 O'LChAM (large, small, big,
    tiny)
  3 YOSh (old, new)
  4 ShAKL (square, round)
  5 RANG (brown, black, blue, grey,
    red, white, green)
  6 MATERIAL (wooden, silk,
    leather, velvet, nylon)
  + OT


JAVOBLAR:

  1 large + brown + wooden
    (o'lcham, rang, material)
  2 small + black + silk
  3 big + square + blue
    (o'lcham, shakl, rang)
  4 light grey + leather
    ('light grey' = och kulrang -
    bitta rang!)
  5 tiny + round + red
  6 lovely + blue + velvet
    (fikr, rang, material)
  7 expensive + big + white
    (fikr, o'lcham, rang) → 'AN'
  8 old + green + nylon
    (yosh, rang, material) → 'AN'


⚠ 'A(N)' - 7, 8:

  'an expensive', 'an old' - unli.


⚠ 'TINY':

  = juda kichik, mitti.


⚠ 'VELVET':

  = baxmal. 'SILK' = ipak.
  'NYLON' = neylon.


⚠ 'A BRIEFCASE':

  = portfel (ish uchun).
  'A RUCKSACK' = ryukzak.

MUST / CAN'T - TAXMIN
  (ISHONCHLI XULOSA).

  MUST be = bo'lsa kerak (ishonch
    bilan HA - dalil bor)
  CAN'T be = bo'lishi mumkin emas
    (ishonch bilan YO'Q - dalil bor)

  ⚠ 'mustn't' bu yerda
  ISHLATILMAYDI - 'must' ning aksi
  taxminda 'can't'.


DALILLAR:

  1 manzil daftari ichida → MUST be
    Elaine's
  2 juda kichik → CAN'T be his
  3 pulini sarflagan → CAN'T be
  4 har doim yorqin rang kiyadi →
    MUST be his
  5 faqat kumush yoqtiradi → CAN'T
    be hers


⚠ 'A £20 NOTE':

  = 20 funtlik pul (qog'oz).
  'a note' = qog'oz pul.


⚠ 'TIM'S SPENT':

  = Tim HAS spent (present
  perfect qisqartmasi).


⚠ 'A BRACELET':

  = bilaguzuk. 'jewellery' =
  zargarlik buyumlari.

exercises.instructionEn: Make speculations about the people in the pictures as in the examples: businessman, student, 18 years old, married, pilot, single, earn a lot of money, work long hours. Sarah (young girl with a rucksack), Timothy (man in a suit on the phone near Big Ben). Example: She must be a student. She can't be married.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratdagi odamlar haqida taxmin qiling, namunalardagidek: businessman, student, 18 years old, married, pilot, single, earn a lot of money, work long hours. Sarah (ryukzakli yosh qiz), Timothy (Big Ben yonida telefonda gaplashayotgan kostyumli erkak). Namuna: U talaba bo'lsa kerak. U turmushga chiqqan bo'lishi mumkin emas.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAXMIN - MUST / CAN'T + BE.

  QOLIP:
  She/He MUST be + OT/SIFAT.
  She/He CAN'T be + OT/SIFAT.
  She/He MUST/CAN'T + FE'L (earn,
  work).


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'She must be a student. She
   can't be married.'


SURATLAR:

  SARAH - yosh, ryukzak, kundalik
    kiyim → student, 18, single,
    can't earn a lot
  TIMOTHY - kostyum, telefon,
    London markazi → businessman,
    earns a lot, works long hours,
    can't be 18 / a student

  ⚠ 'pilot' - ikkalasiga ham
  'can't be a pilot' (forma yo'q).


⚠ 'SINGLE':

  = bo'ydoq / turmush qurmagan.
  'married' ning aksi.


⚠ 'TO EARN':

  = pul topmoq, ishlab topmoq.


⚠ 'TO WORK LONG HOURS':

  = ko'p soat ishlamoq.
exercises.exampleEn: She must be a student. She can't be married.
exercises.exampleUz: U talaba bo'lsa kerak. U turmushga chiqqan bo'lishi mumkin emas.
modelAnswers: Sarah must be 18 years old. She must be single. She can't be a businessman. She can't earn a lot of money.
Timothy must be a businessman. He can't be a student. He can't be 18 years old. He must earn a lot of money. He must work long hours. He can't be a pilot.
modelAnswersUz: Sara 18 yoshda bo'lsa kerak. U turmush qurmagan bo'lsa kerak. U tadbirkor bo'lishi mumkin emas. U ko'p pul topishi mumkin emas.
Timoti tadbirkor bo'lsa kerak. U talaba bo'lishi mumkin emas. U 18 yoshda bo'lishi mumkin emas. U ko'p pul topsa kerak. U ko'p soat ishlasa kerak. U uchuvchi bo'lishi mumkin emas.
